entry.title: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban
entry.summary: Andre McKechnie, 55, is serving a life sentence for murder. He took his battle for the salty, sticky, black-brown byproduct of brewing beer to the court last year. He argued being refused Vegemite breached the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act.

entry.title: What to know about China's plenum as Xi seeks stronger party discipline
entry.summary: This closed-door gathering that started Monday comes about a year before Xi is expected to secure a fourth term and personnel changes to key leadership bodies.

entry.title: Russia says it will open humanitarian corridor to Ukrainian town
entry.summary: Russia says it will open a humanitarian corridor to the occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, where people have been eating weeds and pickles to survive while trapped by minefields, shelling and drones.

entry.title: Brazil's left-wing President Lula elected for fourth term
entry.summary: Brazil's 80-year-old left-wing leader President Lula defeats Flávio Bolsonaro in a bitterly contested runoff.

entry.title: U.S. influence in Latin America at stake in runoff election in Brazil
entry.summary: A polarizing presidential election runoff in Latin America's largest economy and biggest democracy pits leftist Lula da Silva's legacy against Trump ally Flavio Bolsonaro, son of the former Brazilian president.

entry.title: This center-right former general could unseat Netanyahu as Prime Minister in Israel
entry.summary: A former Israeli general is the main center-right challenger hoping to unseat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Israeli elections this week.

entry.title: Venezuela's opposition leader María Corina Machado returns after months in exile
entry.summary: Machado announced her arrival on social media, writing "I am here. With you."

entry.title: Israelis have changed. Will they change their leadership?
entry.summary: Israel is holding a general election this week after years of war. For many Israelis, shaken by the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks and years of war, it is the most consequential in decades.

entry.title: This College of Magic turns ordinary kids into cool magicians
entry.summary: The students, many from marginalized communities, learn to conjure up candy, do card tricks — and face the world with a confident, creative and resilient mindset.

entry.title: Soldiers guard center of Milan as thousands of protesters march in cities across Europe
entry.summary: While protests in France have claimed most international attention, large demonstrations also rocked many European cities Saturday from Milan to Rome to Madrid, Lisbon and Tirana.
